QUESTIONS (asked USPTO but got no reply)...
(1) IF you use a middle name do you include it in the electronic signature e.g. "/John Middle Doe/"? In the signature section it asks you to repeat your first and last name. Do you match that (no middle) or the full signature used everywhere else including middle name? This ambiguity seems potentially critical as many PRINT and SIGN signatures require both to match exactly, but but matching the applicant name exactly could also be critical.
(2) For micro entity do you select "small entity"? (there isn't a micro entity option on the AIA form) I don't want to get charged the small entity rate, however it says elsewhere that micro entity status is small entity status with the additional restrictions (max income etc).
It sure seems like they would ask for the middle name in the signature section AND have a Micro Entity Status option, or at least clear that up in the instructions for the form (they do not).
